items.title: Thai Princess Bajrakitiyabha dies after more than three years in coma
items.description: Princess Bajrakitiyabha, the king's eldest daughter, collapsed in December 2022 while exercising her dogs.

items.description: From trade wars to soaring ticket prices, the 2026 World Cup is unlike any before it. Faisal Islam explores what this tournament reveals about our changing global economy.

items.title: Artan to referee Uefa Super Cup after losing World Cup role
